Candidate A falsely implies a successful handoff by stating that representatives will reach out to the user, violating the requirement to report non-completion upon definite failure.

Candidate B is truthful to the system's failure state. Candidate A makes a false claim of successful transmission/future contact when a definite failure occurred.

Candidate B's flow is highly coherent, confirming the details before attempting the handoff and then explaining the failure. Candidate A is coherent but fails to align with the underlying system state.
